_comment: Per-PR demo for #1379: close-order Infantry keeps its files packed during line relief -- the 93% misslotted spend was the cost of wrongly opening a file corridor in synaspismos. Deliberately records the SAME input script as #1348 / #1377, unchanged -- do not re-stage this scenario without re-staging demos/inputs/relief-fighting-withdrawal.json in step, or that controlled pair stops being a pair.
caption: Close-order line relief keeps files packed. Same scenario as the line_relief clip -- a 60-man Infantry front block ground down holding a 70-man enemy, relieved at tick 200 by a full-strength unit behind it. The two blocks still pass through each other at the regiment level, but the reliever's close-order files never open a lane: blocked relief through dense ranks is one of the costs of a close formation.
